★ Request
Winter Uniform: Show Dober, McQueen, and Bright

Eheheh. W-Welcome to our tea party.
So, Bright... who is this?

However, her running wasn't bad by any means. If you looked past
that first impression and observed closely, you'd see she possessed great staying power.
Waaah, you're exaggerating!

"To become a new beacon of light"... Beneath her gentle, laid-back tone lay
a glimpse of fierce determination. That was likely the very reason she ran.

She looks a bit spaced-out, doesn't she?
But honestly, she has an incredibly strong core.

Yes~. By nature, I seem to be rather slow and easygoing~.
Compared to others, both my thinking and my growth take longer.

Ah... I see. It is coming up soon, after all.
Receiving focused guidance from a specialist is very important.

—Only one week remained until Mejiro Bright's Debut Selection Race. By then,
I needed to help her running improve, but...

...Come to think of it, why did Mejiro Bright decide to entrust her
training to me in the first place? I still didn't know the answer.

And that conviction was the final piece needed for victory.
Belief can sometimes be the driving force for that final step. With that—
—In order to become a new light for the Mejiro family...!

! Yes...! 
Now... pick up the pace...!

We are planning to hold a talk event for the fans soon,
gathering all the Mejiro members who have already debuted.

And above all, the way she runs is simply beautiful~!
So graceful, so elegant, so ideal. It leaves me utterly enchanted every time~.

Indeed. Everyone in our family and staff is truly wonderful.
...Though having Bright host the upcoming event would have been quite amusing.

No, no, Bright brought you along, right?
Then I'm sure there's a good reason for it.
Provisional...?

I am not exaggerating at all, you know?
I truly love and respect all of you from the bottom of my heart.

Fufu, yes! ...I'm not really the type anyone should look up to.
But because it's Bright saying it... that alone gives me confidence.

In a real race, things might not go as practiced. But...
she had a reason she could not afford to lose. That resolve would surely lead to results.

Dober and I haven't debuted yet, so we will merely be observing~.
Oh, if you would like, please join us as well, Provisional Trainer.

Isn't it lovely~? It warms you right in the chest~.
Hot black tea is such a blessing in the cold winter, isn't it?

I'm so glad~. ...Cues are truly wonderful things, aren't they?
Knowing when the time has come makes running feel so delightful~.

Bright's tra— Provisional Trainer!
Thank you for today. Thanks to you, it was a lot of fun!

So powerful, as if every single step makes the earth bounce...
It reflects Ryan-oneesama's inner strength, and I admire it so very much.
—It is shameful for an Umamusume of the 'Mejiro' name.

Dober was the one who taught me to drink it this way~. She is so dependable
and teaches me so much... What a wonderful girl she is, wouldn't you say~?

So, so, how is training with Bright going?
I know you've probably only just started, though!

May I run a bit more~?
My body is full of energy. Please, give me any instruction you wish~.

Whenever I am sunbathing, McQueen-sama
drapes a blanket over me... She is so very kind.

I chose to enter the Debut Selection Race to prove my strength at last.
Yet I knew that at this rate, I would never achieve the result I desire.

Fufufu~.
I truly love Ryan-oneesama's running as well, you know.

Just as I had first sensed, her leisurely nature led to poor starts,
and she struggled to find the right timing to accelerate and unleash her burst.

Provisional Trainer, would you care for some black tea~?
Please, do try adding some stewed apples to it. Here you are~.

Ever since I was a child, all the way until now...
I have disappointed so many people who placed their hopes in me.

From left to right: Dober with her dignified strength, the proud McQueen-sama,
and my beloved, gentle Ryan-oneesama~.

What I taught her was the timing for acceleration. Since it takes time
for her engine to kick in, I gave the cue early. And then—

So, I'm sure she had a solid reason for choosing you.
...Please take good care of her!

I know, right?!
McQueen's running really is so gorgeous~.
Yes. This is my Provisional Trainer~.

Haaah... haaah~...
Provisional Trainer, how was my timing~?

—Well, you see...
It is because you gazed at that dead leaf together with me~.

...That does not mean I think of myself as hopeless.
Even if my pace is slow, I too am an Umamusume of the Mejiro family.

I felt that you would help me prove who I am.
Following in the footsteps of Ryan-oneesama and the others, who have shown so much brilliance...

That was when I met you. If it's someone who could gaze up
at the sky at the very same pace as me, surely...

If I properly instruct her on tactics and when to make her move,
she should be able to run while covering for her weaknesses. All that's left for victory is—
Haa... haaah... All right, right here...! ...Oh, my? I seem to have crossed the goal line again...
—And with that, allow me to make the introductions~.

After enjoying the tea party for a while, everyone returned to the academy.
As I waited alone for Mejiro Bright while she got ready for training...
—Haa... hah...! If I hear your voice, I'll run faster... If only I can hear your voice—
